faq_heading: Uptown condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Uptown. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Uptown, New Westminster: 108 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 13 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 1 of 14 New Westminster communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Uptown rose from 106 in June to 108 in September (+1.9%), and 58 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 24.3% of New Westminster’s 444 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Uptown?
Uptown also had 14 houses listed and 0 sold in September, against 108 condos and townhomes listed. The Uptown houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Uptown home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

125 condos sold in Uptown with a median price of $529,000 (the middle half sold between $405,000 and $627,500), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $548 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $572 a month. 10 townhomes sold in Uptown with a median price of $776,000 (the middle half sold between $678,500 and $894,375), taking a median of 15 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $592 per square foot, a median year built of 1999 and a median strata fee of $616 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Uptown?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 108 condos and townhomes listed in Uptown. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Uptown a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Uptown had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Uptown from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 58 condos and townhomes sold in Uptown over those 4 months, out of 261 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Uptown sell for?
faq.a: 125 condos sold in Uptown between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $529,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Uptown?
faq.a: The median was 25 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
